test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall gate PROXI Wheelbase to LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH a) The Head Unit shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH= [Not_Used] when PROXI Wheelbase = [Invalid]. b) The Head Unit shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH= [Length_1] when PROXI Wheelbase = [2532].

tcs.tc_title: VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH = Not_Used, set the PROXI value and read the LVDS link
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in Standby state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. PROXI Wheelbase = 0 (Invalid)
4. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Read vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH and check that it is Not_Used
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) is sent and the HU completes start-up and reads the PROXI configuration
2. vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH = Not_Used is sent over LVDS
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall gate PROXI Wheelbase to LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH a) The Head Unit shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH= [Not_Used] when PROXI Wheelbase = [Invalid]. b) The Head Unit shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH= [Length_1] when PROXI Wheelbase = [2532].

(VC_WHL_BASE_LENGTH = Not_Used, set the PROXI value and read the LVDS link)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V3-286` 之 `a)` 分支。原句 39 token，未逾 50，主句與兩個子句一併保留（兩分支之 TC 共用同一上半，以括號下半區分，形制同 batch01 之 `NR1L-RVC-017`／`-018`）。依 **R-CAM15(b)**，V42（637）於本驗證點有對應條文（`V42-326`），故 V3 列只承 376。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
